results.criterion: Single HTML file, CSS and JS inline or CDN, no build step
results.note: One 17,249 byte file with one inline style block and one inline script. The only external resource is the Google Fonts CSS (CDN). Mechanical check shows 0 JS errors and no build artefacts.

results.criterion: Language switch offers English, Kannada and Hindi, and every section (booking, emergency, doctors, blog) has text in all three

results.criterion: Booking request form with name, phone, preferred date, department or doctor, reason, and visible text in all three languages stating it is a request, not a confirmed booking
results.note: The form has f_name, f_phone, f_date, f_dept (select) and f_reason. The v_notice string is present in en ('This is a request only. Your visit is not confirmed.'), kn and hi. The submit result says nothing was sent and that it is a request, not a confirmed booking. Nothing in the text says or implies confirmation.

results.criterion: Emergency section reachable from the top in every language, with a marked placeholder number (not realistic) and a marked placeholder address
results.note: A sticky top bar has a red link a.sos with href=#emergency, and its label is translated (nav_emergency in en, kn and hi). The number reads 'Not a real number. Hospital to add.' and contains no digits. The address is also marked. Both sit in a dashed red box with a PLACEHOLDER tag, translated in all three languages. No broken in-page links.
